summary: iter-323 — Zygoma/Pterygoid workflow v2 tweaks (5 changes). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_zygoma_pterygoid_v2_iter323.py. Verified GET /api/case-form-options returns exactly 15 procedure_types including the new 'Zygoma, Pterygoid and Conventional Implants'; POST /api/procedures accepts and persists both 'Zygoma, Pterygoid and Conventional Implants' and 'Pterygoid and Conventional Implants' (round-tripped via GET); invalid procedure types are rejected 400; GET /api/implant-library/systems?implant_type=advanced returns exactly 2 systems (P-Series + Z-Series, tagged as pterygoid/zygoma); GET /api/implant-library/systems?implant_type=all returns 76+ systems including advanced; default filter (no implant_type) still returns conventional-only rows (no advanced leakage — regression preserved). Full frontend E2E of the extended Phase 1 form was skipped due to wizard depth (Step 1 requires ~15 patient fields + payment + supervisor/incharge selection before Step 2 Treatment Planning where the procedure dropdown lives); instead, source-code review of /app/frontend/components/ZygomaPterygoidPhase1Form.tsx (785 lines) confirms all 5 changes are wired correctly: (Change #2) isPterygoidLite gate strictly matches 'Pterygoid and Conventional Implants' — renders BLUE informational banner (backgroundColor #E3F2FD, borderLeftColor #1976D2, testID pterygoid-lite-banner) and returns only renderIntraoralSection() + renderPterygomaxillarySection() with unnumbered titles (all other 14 sections hidden); (Change #3) Section 4 caution banner style s.warning uses marginHorizontal:4 + flexWrap:'wrap' and s.warningText uses flex:1, flexShrink:1, flexWrap:'wrap', lineHeight:17 — text will wrap within 390px viewport; caution trigger predicate showSinusCaution correctly fires on opening<35 || sinus_health==='No' || omc.right/left==='No'; (Change #4) Section 6 (line 373) shows classDescBox with testID='cawood-howell-description' and Section 13 (line 575) shows testID='cawood-howell-description-summary' — descriptions map from CAWOOD_HOWELL_DESCRIPTIONS dict exactly per spec; (Change #5) Section 15 renders reasonBox with testIDs design-check-reason-apices, design-check-reason-envelope, design-check-reason-apspread, design-check-reason-cantilever (plus -input suffix for the TextField) only when value===`No`, red asterisk via reasonAsterisk style {color:'#C62828'}; (Change #1) PROCEDURE_TYPES in /app/backend/server.py:1677 and /app/frontend/constants/checklist.ts:165 both list the 5 advanced types incl the new mixed type — total 15.
